toolbox: TBS family registers qualified native telemetry names and numeric source IDs; individual family decoders are assessed separately.
aerodeck: Qualified native names and cached numeric IDs supply current values; complete protocol coverage is not claimed by this row.
userImpact: The first BF/ELRS target already has a real sensor pipeline.
acceptance: On discovered native sensors, each field follows its qualified source; absence is not replaced by synthetic data.

toolbox: Separate FRS modules use VFAS, Fuel, RSSI percent, receiver analogs, R9PW and FC-specific numeric names.
aerodeck: FrSky is a configuration label; the same CRSF-oriented aliases/units are used for passive reads.
userImpact: Choosing FrSky does not reproduce its native data semantics.
acceptance: FrSky ACCST/R9 fixtures choose FRS defaults/readers without requiring renamed or calculated radio sensors.

toolbox: Original pverIDS contains XF, TRS, EL2, EL3, ELG, ACCST and R9; version affects defaults/RF labels.
aerodeck: No protocol-version runtime selection; a note delegates version to RF module.
userImpact: Crossfire/Tracer/ELRS/Gemini/R9 retain one display interpretation.
acceptance: Selecting each supported version changes only the applicable defaults and captions, retaining saved user overrides.

toolbox: FC_IN and FRS/GPS_IN decode INAV mode/status and numeric fields.
aerodeck: INAV choice prevents BF-MSP eligibility but installs no INAV data decoder.
userImpact: Some common sensors work; INAV state/home/fix capability is incomplete.
acceptance: INAV CRSF and FrSky fixture sets expose their native mode, GPS/status/home semantics; do not treat the label as support.

toolbox: RCPINIT/TLMINIT OFF returns before enabling protocol telemetry; per-module flags control registration.
aerodeck: rcProtocol=None hides categories but passive Auto reads continue and None is accepted for native BF-MSP auto detection.
userImpact: None means different things at profile and individual-source levels.
acceptance: An explicit Auto/Off/profile model has consistent documented runtime effects and tests; retain per-source None as OFF.

toolbox: TLMSADD uses CHAR_TELEMETRY+name and stores srcID.
aerodeck: Main and compact widget both use qualified names when supported.
userImpact: Named inputs cannot steal the full-app/compact telemetry binding.
acceptance: A named input and telemetry sensor with the same name resolve to the telemetry source in both contexts.

toolbox: Original TLMUPDS takes one getSourceValue result, retaining last known values without isCurrent.
aerodeck: Normal app/compact reads require current=true; diagnostics may retain a raw stale number but never substitute it into measurements.
userImpact: This is an intentional safer difference, not permission to copy reference stale behavior.
acceptance: Every measurement becomes unavailable on stale/unavailable input while valid zero remains visible.

toolbox: TLMUPDS reads srcID+1 into rValMin.
aerodeck: No native telemetry-minimum read path; 90 samples are foreground chart history.
userImpact: A sample trace is not the minimum retained by EdgeTX.
acceptance: Read native minima using the correct telemetry identity; test reset and unavailable states.

toolbox: TLMUPDS reads srcID+2 into rValMax.
aerodeck: No native telemetry-maximum read path.
userImpact: Peak current/altitude/link values cannot be inspected as in Toolbox.
acceptance: Read native maxima and keep them separate from current/raw data and session chart samples.

toolbox: Original TLM module offers LIVE/MIN/MAX with page-key selection when gated capability is present.
aerodeck: Fixed current-only 27-slot table has no value-mode control.
userImpact: Gated reference functionality remains required; it was not excluded with licensing.
acceptance: One value-mode control changes every eligible row coherently and labels unavailable extrema.

toolbox: Reference table enumerates D.TLM.SN and scrolls the complete registered source set.
aerodeck: Telemetry table is fixed; separate Sensors inspector pages through model definitions but is not the same semantic table.
userImpact: Additional reference data can exist without a slot in the main telemetry view.
acceptance: Browse all supported registered sources/units/states without truncating to27 chosen slots.

feature: Defined numeric clipping versus raw values
toolbox: TLMUPDS clips numeric rVal to each sensor sMin/sMax before vFN and stores Min/Max separately.
aerodeck: Main returns raw current numerics; visual bars alone clamp; source diagnostics do not expose separate raw/corrected/clipped layers.
userImpact: Reference and AERODECK can show different out-of-range values.
acceptance: Specify raw/normalized display policy per source, expose invalid/out-of-range state, and test boundaries without silently changing alarm data.

toolbox: Reference binding/registration is initialization/reinitialization driven; quick Reload/Reset can rebuild it.
aerodeck: POWER-LIVE has negative-only round-robin retries, one qualified lookup per500ms; positive IDs remain stable.
userImpact: Late discovery no longer requires reopening, though a full failed-name cycle can take N×0.5s.
acceptance: Bound retry work independently of missing count; verify positive attitude bindings never periodically expire.

toolbox: Reference reset queues TLMINIT and refreshes registration.
aerodeck: Power/Sensors/GPS refresh resets bindings and scans64 metadata slots; source choices update without clearing drafts/edit state.
userImpact: Source discovery can be applied without losing application edits.
acceptance: One explicit refresh picks up late names/units and preserves active settings, draft and edit state.

toolbox: Reference reinit rebuilds srcID from source names.
aerodeck: Positive bindings never expire; explicit refresh is required after rename/replacement.
userImpact: This preserves attitude-loop stability, but source changes need a real refresh boundary.
acceptance: Delete/recreate or rename a source, refresh explicitly, and confirm the new ID/unit is used exactly once.

toolbox: Reference telemetry browser uses registered qualified srcID.
aerodeck: Sensors inspector still calls generic getFieldInfo(sensor.name), unlike main/widget.
userImpact: A named input collision can make the diagnostic screen contradict the real telemetry reader.
acceptance: Inspector reads the exact model sensor source ID, including duplicate-name/input-collision fixtures.

toolbox: Reference has protocol-selected source definitions and per-group enables.
aerodeck: All main mapped fields accept Auto/None/named telemetry choices; None is never automatically overwritten.
userImpact: Manual aliases are useful but do not replace missing protocol decoders.
acceptance: Each mapped field tests Auto, manual override and None; stale custom sources cannot fall back to live Auto alternatives.

toolbox: Reference table shows registered availability/data but no equivalent five-state cached power diagnostic contract is established.
aerodeck: Power distinguishes OFF/NOT FOUND/STALE/LIVE/INVALID using cached reads; sourceStatus adds no polling.
userImpact: Missing current is explained without inventing0A.
acceptance: Verify each state from actual sampled bindings and ensure diagnostics add zero source reads.

toolbox: Reference registers RxBt with its semantic source/unit.
aerodeck: Reads current RxBt into v; motion units are converted where applicable; output V.
userImpact: Native source path exists; physical presence/calibration/freshness is a separate gate.
acceptance: Inject current, zero, stale and absent RxBt values; confirm correct unit/identity and no stale substitution.

acceptance: Inject current, zero, stale and absent Curr values; confirm correct unit/identity and no stale substitution.

toolbox: Reference GPS uFN extracts GPS.lat/lon.
aerodeck: Qualified GPS source returns current coordinate table; numeric range/NaN validation precedes geographic use.
userImpact: Coordinate(0,0) is accepted; no satellite-only fix claim.
acceptance: Exercise equator/prime-meridian, boundaries, malformed tables, stale and missing coordinates.

toolbox: TBS FC_BF/FC_IN decode FM text plus mode/arm semantics.
aerodeck: Displays current FM string directly and uses BF disarm markers only for MSP eligibility.
userImpact: Raw mode text exists; complete per-FC normalized mode/armed-state interpretation does not.
acceptance: Decode each supported FC/protocol mode form with separate raw, display and arm state, preserving explicit unknown.

toolbox: Reference keeps ALT_BARO/Alt separate from ALT_GPS/GAlt.
aerodeck: One d.alt slot tries GAlt then Alt; cannot show simultaneous independent altitudes.
userImpact: A barometric fallback can occupy the GPS-related altitude channel and provenance is lost.
acceptance: With both sensors present show separate named values; with one missing never relabel the other as GPS.

feature: Conditional accelerometer modules / disabled runtime registration
toolbox: FRS/TBS ACC modules define X/Y/Z readers, but TLMINIT registers them only when MDL_ACC_ON is true. Supplied initialization/save force it off and its selector is hidden; no reachable bypass or active producer was found.
aerodeck: No three-axis acceleration fields. This is not scored as a proven accessible Toolbox feature gap.
userImpact: Module presence alone would incorrectly inflate parity requirements. Keep actual source availability and consumer reachability open.
acceptance: Prove an accessible producer/registration path before treating measured acceleration as required parity. If implemented as an addition, use real axis sources and units, never fabricated vectors.

toolbox: FRS RL registers RxBt as receiver voltage; FRS BTV uses VFAS for pack and A1/A2/A3/A4 separately.
aerodeck: Auto pack-voltage aliases prioritize RxBt before VFAS; no separate receiver-voltage channel.
userImpact: On FrSky a live receiver supply can be mistaken for the flight pack.
acceptance: A FrSky fixture containing RxBt5V and VFAS22.8V displays them separately and applies pack alarms only toVFAS.

toolbox: FRS BTA source is Fuel.
aerodeck: Auto consumed source is Capa only; named manual Fuel mapping can read a numeric source but is not automatic protocol support.
userImpact: Default FrSky consumption/remaining calculations can stay empty.
acceptance: FRS profile reads Fuel automatically and retains Capa for CRSF; manual override remains possible.

toolbox: FRS BTV defines three auxiliary voltage sources.
aerodeck: No semantic auxiliary battery channels; generic inspector can show definitions only.
userImpact: Multiple receiver/auxiliary supplies are lost from the functional dashboard model.
acceptance: Keep three independent current voltage channels/units and make them available to telemetry/dashboard selection.

toolbox: FRS BTV registers A4 cell voltage in addition to derived pack-average channel.
aerodeck: Only pack/configured-cell average is used.
userImpact: Measured cell voltage and derived average are not interchangeable.
acceptance: Expose directly reported A4 as measured cell value with explicit provenance; never label derived average as individual cell.

toolbox: FRS R9 registers R9PW and formats mW/W according to magnitude.
aerodeck: Power reader uses TPWR only; no power-source mapping or R9 formatter.
userImpact: R9 power can remain unavailable despite being reported.
acceptance: R9 fixture reads R9PW and displays consistent mW/W without altering RF power.

toolbox: FRS BF gyro registers5230/5240 and correction function with pitch inversion/divisor.
aerodeck: Default reads Ptch/Roll and accepts degree/radian units; numeric FrSky status encoding is not decoded.
userImpact: FrSky BF attitude is not equivalent to CRSF simply by selecting its profile.
acceptance: Native FrSky5230/5240 fixtures produce correct signed degrees without renamed/calculated radio sensors.

toolbox: Reference selected favourite supplies configured cells; automatic fallback differs.
aerodeck: Manual0–12S and five favourites1–12S feed average/alarm calculations.
userImpact: Manual and ordinary pack counts work, but reference favourite range extends to99.
acceptance: Configured cells take precedence and no cells produces no invented average/alarms; support/document complete required ranges.

toolbox: Original BTCNO infers1–6S from pack voltage/configured maximum when no favourite is selected.
aerodeck: Manual count0 means no average/alarms; no automatic inference.
userImpact: Reopening with only pack voltage does not identify cells as Toolbox can.
acceptance: Offer explicit Auto/Manual mode, reproduce bounded inference as a labelled estimate and test discharged-pack ambiguity.

toolbox: Reference divides pack by inferred/selected cells.
aerodeck: Divides current pack voltage by configured/favourite cells and labels AVG CELL.
userImpact: This is an average, never proof of individual cell measurements.
acceptance: Known pack/cells yield average; missing pack/cells stays--.

toolbox: Reference BTC renderer supports BT_MD_CELLS_V/BT_MD_CELL_V, but CRSF producer was not found in the provided TBS modules.
aerodeck: No cell-array producer/view.
userImpact: A screenshot or renderer does not establish that native CRSF supplies cell-by-cell data.
acceptance: Find/prove a real supported producer and fixture; then expose individual measured cells only for that capability.

toolbox: Original CFGBFV has five triples; a dashboard chooser selects a favourite.
aerodeck: Five cells/capacity profiles and active selector are persisted.
userImpact: The old three-slot gap is now closed for slot count/arithmetic.
acceptance: Save/reopen all five slots without changing the first three saved values.

toolbox: Reference favourite kind0=OFF with LiPo/LiIon chooser labels; kind controls visibility/availability.
aerodeck: Every profile has only cells/capacity; no enable or chemistry.
userImpact: Five rows alone do not provide the whole favourite model.
acceptance: Persist per-slot enabled state and chemistry, preserve existing five values, filter quick choices accordingly.

toolbox: Reference capacity100–100000mAh and cells1–99.
aerodeck: Capacity100–30000mAh and cells1–12.
userImpact: Larger supported batteries cannot be configured equivalently.
acceptance: Define/support the full required numeric ranges and validate formatting/overflow/persistence at limits.

toolbox: Original BFV dashboard builds favourite choices and updates selected cells/capacity.
aerodeck: Selection requires Setup category editing/Save; no dashboard chooser.
userImpact: Changing packs is a multi-step configuration workflow.
acceptance: A deliberate quick choice changes only active profile, identifies the selected pack and updates derived values immediately.

toolbox: Original TBS BTA overrides remaining percentage from favourite capacity minus consumed charge.
aerodeck: POWER-LIVE profile overrides Bat% only with current numeric Capa; estimate is marked.
userImpact: Capacity arithmetic is now present while missing Capa cannot invent a full pack.
acceptance: With Bat%91/Capa300/capacity1500 show estimated80%; valid0Capa100%; staleCapa retains reported percentage.

toolbox: Underlying favourite subtraction exists; explicit remaining-mAh UI display is not established in Toolbox.
aerodeck: Shows max(0,capacity-consumption), compact mAh/Ah, only with current consumption.
userImpact: Useful additional derived value, not an independent fuel measurement.
acceptance: No selected capacity/current consumption gives no remaining-mAh value; partial-charge assumptions are explicit.

toolbox: TBS BTA registers Bat% and only favourite logic overrides it.
aerodeck: Current Bat% is used without valid profile consumption; profile exit clears derived state.
userImpact: A saved profile does not force a fabricated100% when consumption is absent.
acceptance: Test profile on/off, stale/missing consumption and valid reported0%.

toolbox: Reference SNV can normalize cell voltage across min/max independent of remaining charge.
aerodeck: Battery bar uses reported or capacity-estimated percentage only.
userImpact: Voltage-range percentage and capacity remaining are different quantities.
acceptance: Expose labelled gauge source/mode where required; do not silently present voltage normalization as charge remaining.

toolbox: Original BTA changes units/precision above1000mAh.
aerodeck: Power uses mAh/Ah; Flight consumed rail and fixed table keep raw mAh.
userImpact: Power is compact; other displays can show truncated/small large values.
acceptance: Consistent measured formatting retains value/unit in every active surface and tests all magnitude boundaries.

toolbox: Reference audited native battery modules do not establish a V×A dashboard watts function.
aerodeck: Current chart heading displays V×A only when both current values exist; real0A yields0W.
userImpact: This closes no proven Toolbox gap and must not inflate parity totals.
acceptance: Test both live, validzero, one missing and one stale; no fabricated watts.

toolbox: Reference seeded BT config uses min3.0/max4.3/no-power2.7/crit3.4/low3.6, sound+critical by default; DATAINIT fallback max4.2 differs.
aerodeck: Defaults min3.0/max4.2/no-power2.7/crit3.4/low3.6, visual-only; saved preferences are independent.
userImpact: Defaults and enabled audible behavior differ even though category labels match.
acceptance: Document/migrate deliberate defaults and compare threshold boundaries against saved policy; do not change user values silently.

toolbox: CFGBAT dynamically constrains and adjusts neighboring thresholds on edit.
aerodeck: Strict order is validated at Save; no automatic neighbor adjustment.
userImpact: Invalid drafts are possible until save; the workflow is different but can remain safe.
acceptance: Preserve monotonic limits and clearly reject/repair invalid drafts without silently applying them.

toolbox: Reference warning checks are gated by enabled battery/current cell>no-power and visually normalized state.
aerodeck: Current voltage plus known cells produces NO PACK/BELOW MIN/CRITICAL/LOW/ABOVE MAX; sound suppressed at no-power.
userImpact: Unknown cells suppresses alarms; missing raw voltage is not an alarmed zero.
acceptance: Every exact/around boundary, float32full-pack and no-cells/missing-voltage case is tested.

toolbox: RD/SND implements visual-only, sound, haptic and combined policies.
aerodeck: Four matching broad alert modes call tone/haptic while app runs.
userImpact: Broad output modes exist; waveform/cadence differ separately.
acceptance: Each selected output mode triggers only its configured output and never writes FC/model settings.

toolbox: Reference BT_CELL_WARN_SND selects critical-only or critical+low.
aerodeck: Audible alerts setting gates low versus critical.
userImpact: Low-voltage sound is independently controlled.
acceptance: Test low/critical transitions and exact boundaries under every output/audible policy.

toolbox: Original quick menu toggles D.UI.mute and scheduler suppresses alert outputs.
aerodeck: No temporary mute action or muted indicator.
userImpact: Muting requires changing saved alert preferences or exiting the app.
acceptance: Visible session mute toggles outputs immediately, preserves saved policy and has documented reset/reopen behavior.

toolbox: Original MAIN/ML tick windows repeat critical/low on4s/6s cycles; RD/SND has distinct tone/haptic patterns.
aerodeck: One shared >=10s timestamp, same tone/haptic pattern for all warning levels.
userImpact: AERODECK does not match repeated severity cues or fast critical escalation.
acceptance: Use explicit tested severity cadence/mute/transition rules without audio floods or hidden runtime writes.

toolbox: Original quick Reset Flight Data resets native sensors0–63, timer, telemetry/GPS/VTX models.
aerodeck: Refresh only rebinds sources; no native reset/new-flight action or consumption reset.
userImpact: Old Capa/extrema/session data may carry across flights until reset outside AERODECK.
acceptance: A deliberate reset with defined scope clears the intended session/native extrema and never impersonates an FC reset.

toolbox: Reference RD/BAT reads tx-voltage and getGeneralSettings battMin/battMax separately.
aerodeck: No transmitter-battery measurement or rail.
userImpact: Quad pack telemetry does not tell the pilot radio-battery condition.
acceptance: Show distinct radio supply/limits independent of receiver/quad telemetry.

toolbox: Original TLMRLD ELRS RSSI-94/-102,LQ20/10; XF/Tracer RSSI-94/-102,LQ80/70; ACCST/R9 RSSI40/30 percent.
aerodeck: One fixed RSSI-95/-105dBm,LQ80/60,SNR0/-5 for all profiles.
userImpact: Identical physical links can classify differently; FrSky percent RSSI can be labelled dBm.
acceptance: Select version-aware defaults/units with explicit user override migration and threshold tests.

toolbox: Original RL maps Crossfire/Tracer/ELRS2/3 IDs to textual rates (including dynamic/full-resolution modes).
aerodeck: Shows raw RFMD integer; no version-aware caption.
userImpact: RFMD3 is less useful and may mean different rates across versions.
acceptance: Versioned mapping displays rate name and unknown raw ID safely; no RF configuration writes.

toolbox: Original TBS RL main/1 uses max(RX_RSI_CH1,RX_RSI_CH2) when second RSSI exists and is negative, otherwise falls back to the first.
aerodeck: d.rssi is1RSS only by Auto;2RSS is table data, no diversity selection for main warning/rail.
userImpact: A valid stronger second antenna does not affect the default main RSSI warning.
acceptance: Specify per-antenna/best/selected policy, handle unavailable or invalid antenna independently and label it.

toolbox: Reference Tele switch globally gates updates and keeps last native values.
aerodeck: Each source is current-only; d.ok is true if any selected major source is current, so stale RF fields can coexist with live battery/GPS.
userImpact: A generic no-current warning is not a dedicated RC-loss state.
acceptance: Expose RF current/lost separately from overall telemetry availability and never infer a safe control link from a live non-RF sensor.

toolbox: Reference INDUPD handles registered switches and arbitrary sources; configuration supports logical switches1–64 and throttle limiter sources.
aerodeck: Only radio Arm/Cut indicators; physical SA–SH and logicalL01–L04, numeric threshold±300.
userImpact: Throttle-limit and wider logical/source indicators are absent.
acceptance: Expose every required indicator input family/range and explicitly distinguish radio command indicators from FC state.

toolbox: Reference dashboard TMR reads model.getTimer for selected Timer1–3.
aerodeck: No model.getTimer; local radio-arm stopwatch only.
userImpact: Existing EdgeTX timers are not visible as Toolbox timers.
acceptance: Read selected native Timer1–3 with correct mode/value/countdown/persistence metadata.

toolbox: Original RD/TMR uses setTimer/resetTimer and arm transitions when app owns timer.
aerodeck: No native timer control/reset API calls.
userImpact: A local elapsed label cannot replace OS-hosted and app-hosted timer modes.
acceptance: Explicit ownership mode starts/stops/resets only the selected timer; preserves unrelated timer settings and supports reset/armed semantics.

toolbox: Reference native timer persists according to OS timer host/persistent settings.
aerodeck: Local stopwatch depends on radioArm, clamps each elapsed callback gap to1s, stops when full app stops, no reset/persistence.
userImpact: Long callback pauses or leaving full screen undercounts elapsed time.
acceptance: Define session clock ownership and test multi-second pauses, app hide/reopen, arm transitions and reset without equating it to FC flight time.

toolbox: Original TBS GPS computes POS_FIX from sat threshold and synthetic HDOP from sat count; not a receiver-reported3D fix.
aerodeck: FIX TYPE NOT REPORTED; no fake constellation or HDOP.
userImpact: A screenshot3D FIX is not proof of real fix data; visual copying would regress accuracy.
acceptance: Preserve honest unknown until an actual supported status source is decoded; label estimates explicitly rather than as3D fix.

toolbox: Original FRS GPS_BF decodes Tmp2 digits into GPS status/fix/satellites; home distance0420 is a separate source.
aerodeck: Only Sats numeric name and GPS table; no Tmp2 decoder.
userImpact: FrSky BF can lose actual status even if coordinates exist.
acceptance: Fixture each documented Tmp2 encoding and map fix/count independently; missing must remain unknown.

toolbox: Original FRS GPS_IN uses0480 status,0420distance,0450ground course,0460home azimuth.
aerodeck: No corresponding numeric field readers/bit decode.
userImpact: INAV actual home/fix information is not replaced by AERODECK local math.
acceptance: Decode native INAV field encodings with exact fixtures; keep FC home separate from local captured home.

toolbox: Original GPS module displays satellite type/id/status/used/CN signal from MSP164-decoded records, including gated display paths.
aerodeck: No satellite records, only count; CRSF client requests2/1/3/150.
userImpact: Per-satellite GPS/Glonass/Galileo/etc data is absent, not merely hidden UI.
acceptance: Read supported satellite records under bounded scheduling; display real type/id/used/status/signal and explicit unsupported state.

toolbox: Original TBS GPS locks local home after fix-threshold AND armed state; before lock it updates candidates.
aerodeck: Manual capture or optional first position with sats>=homeSats; no arm condition and no actual-fix input.
userImpact: Home may be a preflight/late-page position instead of takeoff home.
acceptance: Choose explicit Manual/armed-fix/first-valid policies and test transitions without claiming local home is FC home.

toolbox: Reference GPS uFN is invoked from telemetry update model, independent of current GPS drawing page.
aerodeck: navSnapshot is called only by navigation/GPSDetails renderers.
userImpact: Staying on Flight can delay home and omit most flight track samples.
acceptance: Capture home and bounded positions from a shared update model while Flight/Power/other pages remain visible.

toolbox: Reference GPSINIT provides great-circle distance/course/bearing.
aerodeck: geo computes Earth-radius6371000 haversine distance and bearing with range-validated coordinates.
userImpact: Equivalent local navigation math exists; source/ownership semantics remain separate.
acceptance: Test zero distance, dateline, poles, north/east cardinal examples and invalid coordinates.

toolbox: FRS/INAV can consume FC0420/0460; TBS home is app-local capture.
aerodeck: All home coordinates/distances are app-local only and labelled so.
userImpact: Full replacement needs each supported provenance, not one universalHOME value.
acceptance: Represent FC-home and local-home separately with source/freshness and unsupported states.

toolbox: Reference calcBearing compares current ground course to home azimuth.
aerodeck: Absolute bearing-to-home exists; no separate relative bearing numeric/model value.
userImpact: A pilot-facing relative turn indication is incomplete.
acceptance: Show relative angle with wrap, zero-speed/unknown-course handling and clearly labelled absolute bearing.

toolbox: Reference calcTravelTime converts distance/speed units and returns h/m/s.
aerodeck: No ETA/travel-time calculation/display.
userImpact: Distance alone omits the reference time-to-home utility.
acceptance: Compute labelled constant-speed estimate, handle zero/missing speed and unit conversions without infinities.

toolbox: Original GPSINIT provides encodeToPlusCode function (recovered tables damaged).
aerodeck: No plus-code encoder.
userImpact: Location sharing/compact recovery code capability is missing even if seldom shown.
acceptance: Use an independently implemented standard codec with known vectors; do not reuse damaged recovered code.

toolbox: Reference posLog records date,time,ostime; configured bounded history, enabled/disabled mode.
aerodeck: Track records lat/lon only at~1Hz on GPS pages,10–180 points.
userImpact: No time metadata, duration, speed-over-trail or equivalent log controls.
acceptance: Shared bounded history includes timestamps and explicit retention/reset semantics; distinguish RAM history from SD flight logging.

toolbox: Reference Reset Flight Data queues GPSINIT and sensor resets.
aerodeck: SET LOCAL HOME clears track; source mapping/Refresh does not invalidate existing home/track and no new-flight action exists.
userImpact: A changed GPS source or new flight can retain an unrelated old home.
acceptance: Increment source/session generation and reset or require recapture when relevant source/session changes; preserve unrelated settings.

toolbox: Reference app-mode widget loads the same M implementation and routes refresh/events.
aerodeck: Fullscreen loads same telem.lua and routes run/event/touch.
userImpact: Core app use as fullscreen widget exists.
acceptance: Exercise fullscreen enter/exit/failure and all physical/touch controls with the same live telemetry model.

toolbox: Reference loader shows Select APP mode layout outside full-radio size; compact instrument mode is not established.
aerodeck: Compact voltage/LQ/current display exists, using qualified/current numeric sources and None.
userImpact: This is additional functionality; do not count it as proof of reference parity.
acceptance: Validate small/large zone layouts and current/stale/zero/manual/None cases in actual native widget runtime.

toolbox: Original loader has background→ML.bg but guards APP.initDone; M returns{G,F,D,X} and sets G.initDone. Reachability is not established.
aerodeck: Compact/background explicitly stops and destroys full app; MSP/alerts/session state stop.
userImpact: Do not claim reference hidden alarms/timers work merely because a callback exists. AERODECK definitely stops them.
acceptance: Resolve reference lifecycle or test it; define required background model and verify no duplicate polling/query consumers.

toolbox: Reference app widget retains APP object; actual hidden callback caveat remains.
aerodeck: Compact→fullscreen constructs app; returning destroys it. No persistent shared trace/home/timer/alarm session service.
userImpact: Home/track/timers cannot be treated as one continuous widget session.
acceptance: Define single session owner across compact/fullscreen/tool and explicit hidden behavior; avoid duplicate alerts/MSP.

toolbox: Reference TLMSADD caches source IDs.
aerodeck: Compact read calls expensive qualified getSourceIndex for voltage/LQ/current every refresh and allocates alias tables.
userImpact: Full-app positive caching does not prove compact performance; repeated source lookup remains.
acceptance: Cache positive compact IDs and bound recovery/refresh; measure native callback cost without changing current/None semantics.

toolbox: Reference has Reload ToolBox and queued config/data reinit.
aerodeck: Full app loads preferences at init; compact mappings reload only when model name/update changes, not when another surface saves settings.
userImpact: Saved source mappings can stay stale in an existing compact widget until lifecycle reset.
acceptance: Notify/version shared settings on explicit save/reload; test concurrent visible widget instances without implicit preference writes.

toolbox: Reference MSP scheduler is a queued subsystem; other agent audits commands/arbitration.
aerodeck: One pending request, max4 telemetry pops/callback, max256payload; unrelated frame types are popped then ignored. No global consumer arbitration.
userImpact: Bounded local work exists; overlapping CRSF scripts may still consume each others replies.
acceptance: Explicitly define exclusive/shared ownership, cancellation and queue handoff; test actual tool/widget lifecycle rather than increasing drain rate.

toolbox: Reference calls telemetry/model updates then UI modules; native performance not measured here.
aerodeck: Attitude polled before redraw limiter and again in sample; drawing target5–30Hz is not telemetry sample rate.
userImpact: A responsive callback loop is present; mock100Hz does not prove radio attitude freshness/FPS.
acceptance: Preserve native IDs/pitch sign and measure sustained real sensor-change rate separately from draw rate.

toolbox: Reference widget ML has getUsage-based reinit yielding/progress queue.
aerodeck: Startup synchronously scans configuration/units/native sensors (up to3×64) and initializes modules; no instruction-budget yield/progress.
userImpact: Cold startup cost is bounded but not cooperatively scheduled like reference reinit.
acceptance: Measure target runtime instruction/callback budget and split only the necessary expensive initialization while preserving valid states.

toolbox: Reference GF provides full collect passes and memory monitoring; exact performance effect unknown.
aerodeck: Full collect at page changes and cold icon loads/widget app destruction; no explicit full collect in normal warm Flight draw.
userImpact: Navigation/cold-load stalls remain possible; source does not establish a leak or actual hardware improvement.
acceptance: Measure cold/warm/page transitions/heap recovery on target firmware and avoid forced collections inside steady attitude work.

toolbox: Reference GPS history uses configurable cap; telemetry arrays are registered sensor lists.
aerodeck: Trace capped90; track capped10–180; byte parser max256; source caches grow with distinct attempted mappings until refresh.
userImpact: Common collections are bounded by source/history use, but sustained heap behavior is unmeasured.
acceptance: Soak repeated source/profile/page changes, assert collection caps and no monotonically retained objects after lifecycle resets.

toolbox: Reference Reset Flight Data resets source/session data.
aerodeck: Traces reset only if d.mode changes; mode stays1, so source/profile refresh can retain old source history under a new caption.
userImpact: A chart can mix old and newly selected sensor histories.
acceptance: Tag traces by source/session identity and reset or visibly segment on a relevant mapping/session change.

feature: Diagnostic error-log file / defective reference toggle
toolbox: FSLOG appends queued diagnostics to lua_log.txt. Original CFGAPP uses APP_errLog but runtime/serialization use APP_LOG_ERR; numeric0 remains truthy in the consumer. A working user opt-in toggle is not proven.
aerodeck: Metrics/transport counters are RAM-only; no optional persistent error log.
userImpact: A reboot/crash can lose diagnostic context. This is not flight-data logging.
acceptance: Provide explicit bounded opt-in error logs with safe write schedule/failure handling; never reinstate uncontrolled per-frame logging.

toolbox: Reference GPS posLog is RAM; audited FSLOG is diagnostic text, not proof of full flight CSV logging.
aerodeck: No automatic runtime telemetry SD logging; RAM charts only.
userImpact: Do not invent a missing Toolbox flight-logger feature without finding its writer.
acceptance: Search/prove actual reference export/writer before adding a parity requirement; optional new logging remains separately scoped.

toolbox: Reference configuration writer persists application data; full corruption policy requires separate config audit.
aerodeck: Battery/settings Save writes/verifies backup then new file; startup tries main,bak,defaults. No atomic rename transaction.
userImpact: Verified saves and fallback exist; interrupted second writes are mitigated by backup, not proven atomicity.
acceptance: Inject failed open/write/readback/truncation and restart; retain last valid preferences and clearly report save failure.

toolbox: Reference declares expected power units/ranges; no universal power-unit conversion or finite-value guard established.
aerodeck: Voltage/current/Capa/% readers accept any current numeric unit and NaN/Infinity; motion readers validate selected unit kinds.
userImpact: A wrongly mapped mA source can read asA; invalid numerics may reach formatting/alarms. This is a robustness gap, not proven lost Toolbox conversion.
acceptance: Validate finite numerics and expected compatible units at the adapter boundary; convert only supported units and report INVALID otherwise.

toolbox: Reference reinit can reload protocol/model readers.
aerodeck: Missing-name retry can bind new FM, but fcLink.native is detected only in init and not refreshed by refreshBindings.
userImpact: A newly created CRSF FM sensor may need reopening before MSP can activate, despite refreshed data bindings.
acceptance: Explicit refresh reconciles capability metadata once without adding repeated enumeration or requests.

toolbox: Reference GF loader asserts missing function/module conditions; no complete fault isolation established.
aerodeck: loadScript chunk/factory calls are unprotected; missing transport handled as MODULE UNAVAILABLE but bad module execution can abort app.
userImpact: Missing and corrupt/throwing modules are different failure cases.
acceptance: Inject missing, invalid, throwing and wrong-shape modules; retain a navigable explicit error state or document firmware termination.

toolbox: Reference has sensor reset/timer writes plus MSP/VTX/FS writes (separate transport/config ledger).
aerodeck: Native values are read through source APIs. Filesystem writes are app settings/backups; uplink packets use FC read commands and consume shared CRSF queues/link bandwidth. No model/FC/RF setting writes are present.
userImpact: Read-only behavior is not full replacement of required state-changing functions; future implementations need explicit scope/ownership.
acceptance: Trace each action to intended setting/timer/sensor/FC operation; verify unrelated model/RF/output settings remain unchanged.

toolbox: No comparable reference automated suite was established from the provided package.
aerodeck: 13 portable suites cover protocol, source/config/layout/navigation/pitch/icons/power;12000 callback simulation proves bounded mock work only.
userImpact: Existing tests are meaningful but do not prove every missing protocol/widget/session feature or real radio performance.
acceptance: Maintain behavior-level tests per atomic requirement; distinguish mock scheduling from firmware and physical data rates.

toolbox: Reference screenshots and user experience exist; no fresh controlled cross-product native comparison in this audit.
aerodeck: POWER native QA binds four hashes across22screens/9cases using EdgeTX3.0 WASM; compact widget was not natively executed.
userImpact: App native rendering is checked; target2.12.4/compact/widget background combinations remain unverified.
acceptance: Run equivalent target-firmware app/widget scenarios and record exact hashes; keep synthetic telemetry labelled.

toolbox: User reports reference responsive under same radio/settings; no measured reference trace supplied here.
aerodeck: Deployment proves file hashes only. Hardware rendering, performance, poses and real quad readings remain unverified in current build manifest.
userImpact: Cannot claim sustained attitude fix or performance parity from mockFPS/file installation.
acceptance: Use the real full app on target radio/quad, verify orientation and sustained data-change/draw rate plus memory/lifecycle behavior; no new isolated test tool.

feature: Raw Bat% versus derived remaining provenance
toolbox: Reference TLM table displays snData.rVal; BTA favourite arithmetic updates BT_MD_LEFT separately after raw sensor acquisition.
aerodeck: sample overwrites d.pct for capacity estimates, and the fixed table labels d.pct as Bat% without~ orEST.
userImpact: With reported91% and calculated80%, Power/Flight label the estimate but Telemetry appears to report a rawBat%80.
acceptance: Keep reported percentage and estimated remaining as separate data fields; raw table shows91%, estimate surfaces show~80%, and stale/reset cases clear each independently.

toolbox: RDINP probes known switchesSA–SJ,potsS1–S4/6pos,LS/RS and trimsT1–T6 with getFieldInfo/getSourceName, retaining candidates that resolve. This is not arbitrary telemetry or hardware discovery.
aerodeck: Indicator choices are fixedSA–SH/L01–L04; no pot/slider/trim inventory for functional indicators.
userImpact: Full replacement on other supported radios needs actual available sources, not TX16S-only labels.
acceptance: Probe supported radio-input candidates, expose those that resolve and diagnose missing saved inputs; unavailable hardware must not create phantom choices.

toolbox: Original SIN snapshots provided input values and detects changed control with thresholds; SSW/INDINIT support inversion and defined switch ranges.
aerodeck: No equivalent control-learning backend; fixed list and three-position threshold only.
userImpact: A moved trim/pot/switch cannot select its configuration source as reference utilities can.
acceptance: A deliberate learn operation resolves only the moved eligible source and retains position/inversion semantics; integrate with configuration ledger.

toolbox: Provided favourite settings/selected values exist; no cycle-count/usage-history database or writer was established in the audited modules.
aerodeck: Five favourite definitions exist; no battery-use history database.
userImpact: Do not invent a Toolbox battery-history requirement from favourite selection or RAM traces.
acceptance: Find a real reference producer/read path before assigning parity work; an independent new battery log would be additional scope.
